name: Nagarajah
body:
The nagarajah are an ophidian humanoid race descended from humans who underwent an ancient mystical transformation to guard the prisons of the infernal dragons and resist magical taint. Bearing iridescent scales and subtle serpentine grace, they are natural guardians and potent practitioners of arcane secrets.

Standard Racial Traits
Ability Score Racial Traits: Nagarajah are graceful and intellectually sharp, but often cold and detached. They gain +2 Dexterity, +2 Intelligence, and -2 Charisma.
Type: Humanoid (reptilian). Nagarajah are humanoids with the reptilian subtype.
Size: Medium. Nagarajah have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.
Base Speed: Normal Speed. Nagarajah have a base land speed of 30 feet and a swim speed of 20 feet.
Languages: Nagarajah begin play speaking Common and Draconic. Those with high Intelligence scores can choose from: Aquan, Celestial, Ignan, Infernal, and Undercommon.
Senses and Defense Racial Traits
Low-Light Vision: Nagarajah can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.
Scales of the Ashen Dragon: Fine, iridescent scales grant a +1 natural armor bonus to Armor Class.
Taint Resistance: Nagarajah receive a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against curses, poison, and effects with the [evil] descriptor.
Offense and Magical Racial Traits
Bite Attack: A nagarajah possesses a primary bite attack dealing 1d4 points of piercing damage (plus Strength modifier).
Fire Affinity: Spells with the [fire] descriptor cast by a nagarajah deal +1 point of fire damage per die rolled.
Serpentine Senses: Nagarajah receive a +2 racial bonus on Perception and Stealth checks.
